content.premise: Saltstair is a fishing town on the seaward end of a long green peninsula. One street climbs from the quay to a square at the top in five terraces, each a flight of stone steps above the last, and the houses stand on the terraces. The party arrives on the square in the afternoon and walks the street down to the water.
content.theme: A stone-and-timber fishing town stepping down a hillside to its quay, one box per building and per connector.
content.title: Saltstair
